questions.text: The radius of a sphere is 1.65 cm. Find the exact surface area (in cm2) of this sphere.
The ratio of the number of boys to that of the girls in a school is 9 : 13. If the total number of boys and girls in the school is 2134, what is the number of boys in that school?
The price of a computer is ₹34,000. What will be the price of the computer (in ₹) after a reduction of 17%?

The average height of 16 students of a group is 160 cm. If the average height of the first 6 students in the group is 150 cm and those of the last 8 students is 165 cm, then find the average height of the remaining two students, in cm.
The salaries of P and Q together amount to ₹4,32,000. P and Q spend 75% and 61% of their salaries, respectively. If their savings are equal, then what is P’s salary?
The simple interest on ₹24,000 at a certain rate of interest for 3 years is ₹7,200. What will be the compound interest(compounded annually) on the same sum at the same rate and for the same time?
A garrison of 1500 men has provisions for 12 days. How long will the provisions last if the garrison is increased to 2000 men?
Which of the following numbers is greater than the sum of all the prime factors of 1560?

The marked price of a table lamp is ₹1,500. If the marked price is 20% above the cost price and the table lamp is sold at a discount of 10%, then find the profit percentage.

Aman bought two chairs for ₹1,800. He sold the first chair at a 12% profit and the second one at a 20% profit. Had he sold the first chair at a 20% profit and the second one at a 12% profit, he would have received ₹36 more. Find the difference between the cost-price of the two chairs.
